title: Apple clang -Werror: rpl_messages.h opt_iter pointers lack nullability
description: Host compile of any TU that includes lichen/rpl_messages.h with Apple clang 21 (clang-2100) -Wall -Wextra -Werror fails on -Wnullability-completeness for struct lichen_rpl_opt_iter.data and struct lichen_rpl_raw_opt.data (rpl_messages.h around lines 397 and 407). Triggered because rpl_dodag.h/rpl_messages.h use real _Nonnull/_Nullable when __has_feature(nullability). Out of scope for project-LICHEN-worker6-k35h (stay off messages.c). Fix: annotate those two fields _Nullable (opt_iter.data may be NULL after init with NULL data; raw_opt.data is only valid after a successful next). Do not change codec behavior.
